units: <cite ref="Megillah 14a:1">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>לאחד … תל וכ׳</he> one had a mound in his field, and another had a trench.
<cite ref="Megillah 14a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מכור לי תִּילְּךָ</he> sell me thy mound (to fill up my trench).
<cite ref="Berakhot 30a:10">Ber. 30ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00140"><he>פֶּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:2">Ib. to V, 11</cite> <he>יכולות … ולעשותו תל</he> they can ruin a world and make it a mound (ruin); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="V00451"><he>תִּלִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="V00452"><he>תִּלִּין</he></cite>, <cite ref="V00014"><he>תִּי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 29b:3">Men. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>תִּילֵּי ת׳</he> (later ed. <he>תילין ת׳</he>), v. <cite ref="S00534"><he>קוֹץ</he> I</cite>; Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Genesis 1:1">B’resh. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 21b:24">Erub. 21ᵇ</cite>. Cant. R. l. c. <he>תילי ת׳ הן</he> they are piles on piles (of ideas), v. <cite ref="S01115"><he>קִיץ</he></cite> h.; a. e.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:7">Num. R. s. 10<sup>7</sup></cite> <he>מסודרות ת׳ ת׳</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 1:1:14">Y. Ned. I, 36ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>תילי ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S00265"><he>קְווּצּוֹת</he></cite>; (Bab.
ib. 9ᵇ, a. e. תלתלים); a. e.—תל ארזא, v. אַרְזָא.—[תִּלִּים, תִּלִּין psalms, v. תְּהִלָּה.]
